messages:
Oncall-Bot: :rotating_light: paging @alexc @mirat @danr — SEV2 Elevated 5xx/timeouts reported from private-vpc egress for tenant: acme-corp. Symptoms: burst of 504s and gateway timeouts starting ~17:10 UTC. Please respond.
Alex C.: I'm on it. seeing a spike in 504s on /v1/infer for acme-corp (dedicated). Rolling logs now.
Mira T.: can you paste sample logs? also are they on dedicated or private deployment? I think private VPC egress.
Alex C.: private VPC, NAT in front of transit appliance. sample error line: "upstream request timed out (504) while reading response header from upstream". rate of failures ~25% for last 5m.
Dan R.: pulling NAT metrics now — ephemeral port utilization at 98% on nat-01 in us-east-1, conntrack count high. existing SNAT pool seems exhausted.
Sophia P.: that matches flow logs — lots of long-lived connections to model-backend on port 443, many from same source IPs (dedicated workers).
Alex C.: hypothesis: ephemeral port depletion causing new TCP connections to fail -> LB/gateway returns 504. can we confirm conntrack drops?
Dan R.: yes, kernel reports "nf_conntrack: table full" spikes. netstat shows many connections in TIME_WAIT and some in CLOSE_WAIT from worker processes.
Mira T.: any recent deploys that changed keepalive behavior or increased concurrency? did Optimize rollout change batching?
Alex C.: no deploys in last hour. but acme ramped traffic via a scheduled load test. they forgot to warn us. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1287
Oncall-Bot: incident channel auto-notes: running runbook 'vpc-egress-504s' — follow checklist.
Dan R.: mitigation options: 1) recycle NAT instance to free ports 2) expand ephemeral port range on NAT nodes 3) add additional NAT gateway as pool 4) apply temporary egress path via hosted fallback.
Sophia P.: recycle NAT will drop existing flows — could impact in-flight inference (might make some calls fail). expanding ephemeral range is safer but needs kernel sysctl and rollout across nodes.
Alex C.: short term: start a hot standby NAT gateway and shift a subset of customer subnets to it. can ops create new NAT node and attach route table? ops team? @danr can you coordinate?
Dan R.: creating nat-02 now. running terraform apply for nat pool. command: ```terraform apply -var='region=us-east-1' -target=aws_nat_gateway.nat-02``` ETA ~3m.
Mira T.: while that's happening, let's patch conntrack to drop stale entries: `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` and increase `nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_time_wait`. But changing sysctls on prod hosts requires change window — will do on NAT node only.
Dan R.: nat-02 provisioned, attaching route table to private subnet-ids (subnet-aaa, subnet-bbb). switching 10% of traffic for acme-corp to nat-02 via route propagation. made change at 17:20 UTC.
Alex C.: rolling metrics now — 5xx rate down from 25% -> 6% in the switched subset. overall still ~12% because many subnets still on nat-01.
Sophia P.: Ops: can we add a temporary SNAT pool on transit appliance? that would immediately free up ports for outgoing connections.
Dan R.: applied temporary SNAT-POOL of 8192 ports on nat-01. sysctl increased on nat-01. conntrack table cleared with `echo 1 > /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_flush` on nat-01. doing that in 30s.
Mira T.: be careful with flushing conntrack; will break established sessions. customers might see retries. ack.
Alex C.: flushed conntrack on nat-01 at 17:24. immediate drop in TIME_WAIT entries. 504 rate now ~3.5%.
Oncall-Bot: customer-impact note: acme-corp 17:10-17:28 UTC ~14% error spike peak. Affected endpoints: /v1/infer, /v1/chat. Estimated affected requests: ~12k failed requests during peak.
Dan R.: follow-on actions: 1) add nat-02 permanent 2) increase ephemeral port range kernel param on all NAT nodes 3) adjust worker keepalive reuse settings + decrease ephemeral TLS session churn 4) add monitoring alert for conntrack >= 85%.
Sophia P.: I'll open a PR to tune client keepalive and batch timeouts to reduce concurrent connections. linking: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/542
Alex C.: messaging for customers: drafting a note to acme support on incident, root cause = ephemeral port exhaustion on private NAT due to high concurrency + long-lived flows, mitigations applied, recommended long-term fix: increase SNAT pool or use dedicated egress per-tenant.
Mira T.: handing to night oncall @sophia for follow-up. night handoff: current status stable with 504s <1% for acme, nat-02 handling ~30% of traffic, sysctl changes applied. please monitor conntrack and 5xx rates for next 6h.
Sophia P.: ack, taking over. will join postmortem. creating follow-up ticket with actions and owner assignment. ticket: INC-1287-REMEDY.
Dan R.: added alert rule: `conntrack_usage > 85% for 5m` and dashboard panel for ephemeral ports by nat-id.
Alex C.: thanks all. triage notes saved to incident doc. Next steps: postmortem, customer RCA, consider automated scaling for SNAT pool.
Oncall-Bot: incident resolved (mitigated) at 17:28 UTC — monitoring for recurrence. :white_check_mark:"
